sections.label: ✨ Improve
items: Every sortable table in a Discogs window (an artist's discography, a label's releases and sublabels, a master's versions) and the release-group window's releases table now has three sort states: ascending, descending, and a third click back to the order the site gives. A heading in that initial order shows a faint ⇅ (the release-group window's ↕ became ⇅ too), and its hover text says what the next click does.
A Discogs artist's Have heading now also sorts the other way on the second click (fewest first) before returning to Discogs' order; until now its second click went straight back.
Performance: link-preview windows only; no change to the page tables' filter, sort or render path.
